Subject: Post-call recap & proposed POC success criteria (Stellar Commerce)

Thanks again for a productive kickoff today — great to meet the Stellar Commerce team. Per our call, attaching the initial POC risk tracker and a draft success criteria doc. High-level recap and next steps below:

Summary / goals
- Validate Redwood's inference throughput and latency on your real workload (search re-ranker + chat assist).
- Confirm integration path (API vs dedicated private deployment) for the pilot timeframe.
- Measure unit cost and basic quality metrics on your evaluation prompts.

Proposed success criteria (draft)
- Latency: 95th percentile < 350ms for re-ranker workload under baseline QPS (TBD).
- Throughput: sustain 75 QPS for re-ranking test set for 30 minutes with <1% error rate.
- Quality: match or exceed baseline model F1/AUC over the provided eval set (see sheet).
- Operational: one-click rollback and runbook validated during pilot.

Open items / owners
- Provide final eval prompt set and sample traffic: Stellar (Olivia) — by Fri 2026-08-06.
- Confirm baseline latency/throughput targets: Stellar + Redwood (Marissa/Nikhil) — by Mon 2026-08-09.
- Runtime logs access & temporary support token: Redwood (Dev) — available at start of POC.
- Risk tracker ownership: Marissa (sales) + Stephanie (CS).

Immediate next steps
1) Olivia to upload eval set to shared Drive (link below).
2) Redwood to create a short runbook for onboarding and testing (Dev/Nikhil).
3) Weekly check-ins: propose Tuesdays 10am PT starting 2026-08-11.

Attachments: poc-risk-tracker-stellar-commerce.xlsx (spreadsheet with issues, owners, severity)

If anything above needs correction, please flag. Otherwise we'll treat the tracker as source-of-truth for blockers/mitigations.

Best,

Subject: Blocking runtime bug found — mitigation plan and logs attached

Team — quick engineering update based on the first onboarding run this morning:

Issue observed
- During the initial re-ranker load test (10k tokens/min), we observed an intermittent KV cache deserialization error in the dedicated runtime that causes a worker to drop requests (~0.3% error rate). Full stack trace attached (redwood-runtime-log.txt).

Impact
- Current impact: transient request failures under sustained re-ranker QPS. Not reproducible on small synthetic runs.

Mitigation plan
1) Immediate: we will disable the KV-prefetch optimization for Stellar's POC fleet (reduces throughput by ~5% but eliminates the error) — ETA 60 minutes.
2) Root-cause: engineering will run a deterministic replay on a dev cluster to capture repro and fix serialization patch — ETA 3 business days.
3) If the KV path fix is delayed beyond 3 business days, we propose a short-term fallback to hosted API for re-ranking tests while still using Dedicated for other workloads.

Escalation path
- If we see error rate >1% after mitigation or new blocking behavior, Dev -> Nikhil -> Marissa for a support credit/priority bug fix and potential temporary rollback.

I've attached the runtime log and updated the tracker with the mitigation steps. Will post status updates in the tracker and ping here after the disable.

-Dev Patel
Staff Engineer, Redwood Inference
